lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Laws for Sharing the Road — Bikes, Trucks & Horses
prompt: When driving adjacent to urban light rail tracks in Dallas or Houston, what is strictly prohibited?

options.text: Operating windshield wipers within one hundred feet of an overhead rail line
Stopping, standing, or parking on transit tracks or turning across train paths
Listening to car stereo audio broadcasts while traveling near rail stations
Changing headlights to low beams while driving parallel to train tracks
